_comment: Ten PG&E-area transmission substations at the ends of the day-ahead constraints CAISO's Department of Market Monitoring lists as most congested in 2025 (2025 Annual Report on Market Issues and Performance, Table 5.3, 'Impact of congestion on day-ahead prices - top 25 primary congestion constraints'). congestion_share is the share of 2025 hours the named constraint bound in the day-ahead market, as printed in that table; where a substation ends several listed constraints, the most frequent is used. DMM reports the three most impactful of these binding during solar hours, hour-ending 9 through 16-17; the others are assumed to follow the same pattern. Coordinates are approximate (to within a few km) and come from public maps, not CAISO data -- good enough for a solar resource, not for siting.
_comment_pnode: pnode is the CAISO pricing node whose day-ahead LMP stands in for the site's price: the substation's lower-voltage load node where OASIS has one (Los Banos only has its 500 kV bus). Chosen by name match against OASIS's node list, not from a published mapping.
